## PERSISTENT OR RECURRENT URETHRITIS OR CERVICITIS
Retreat with initial treatment regimen if patient was non-compliant with initial
treatment regimen or re-exposed to an untreated sex partner. If infection is not
due to non-compliance with treatment regimen or re-exposure to an untreated sex
partner, infection is most commonly caused by M. genitalium and less commonly T.
vaginalis.
## Treatment for persistent or recurrent urethritis and failure of initial
## doxycycline treatment
[Metronidazole 2 gm PO ONCE ($) [DI] Azithromycin 1 gm PO ONCE ($) [M]](orz-set-abx-metronidazole-2gm-po-x1-azithromycin-1gm-po-once)
## Failure of above treatment
Consult Infectious Diseases (inpatient)
